text: STAB(M) is the projection of the n-qubit stabilizer polytope onto the expectation-value coordinates of the finite Pauli measurement set M.
RoM_M is the minimum l1 norm of a signed affine decomposition of the measured expectation vector over a generating V-representation of STAB(M).
The source claims that RoM_M(E(rho)) is at most RoM_M(rho) for every trace-preserving stabilizer operation E while the Pauli window M is held fixed.
For M={X,Z}, a pure qubit with Bloch vector (1/sqrt(2),1/sqrt(2),0) has RoM_M=1, but the free Clifford exp(-i pi X/4) maps its visible coordinates to (1/sqrt(2),1/sqrt(2)), where RoM_M=sqrt(2).

For a finite set M of m n-qubit Pauli strings, STAB(M) is the convex hull of v_(S,f), where S ranges over maximal independent sets of the anticommutation frustration graph G_M and f ranges over the admissible sign assignments B_S.

quantifiers: for every finite n-qubit Pauli measurement set M
logical_form.conclusion: STAB(M) = conv{v_(S,f) : S maximal independent in G_M, f in B_S}

text: M is a finite set of fixed Hermitian involutions representing distinct nonidentity n-qubit Pauli phase classes, with no duplicate or plus/minus-duplicate class.

For a commuting context S of phase-free rank r, phase-aware admissible sign functions B_S are in bijection with the 2^r eigenvalue assignments on an independent binary-symplectic basis of S; equivalently the associated signed generators do not generate minus identity.
Every admissible signed maximal commuting context (S,f) has a nonempty joint eigenspace and extends to a pure stabilizer state whose M-projection is v_(S,f).
The M-projection of every pure stabilizer state is a convex mixture of v_(S,f) for one maximal commuting extension S of its nonzero measured support and phase-aware f in B_S.
Under the normalized signed-Pauli assumptions, STAB(M) equals the convex hull of v_(S,f) over inclusion-maximal commuting contexts S and phase-aware admissible signs f; each listed point is extreme.

quantifiers: for every finite normalized n-qubit Pauli measurement set M
logical_form.conclusion: STAB(M) = conv{v_(S,f)} and every listed v_(S,f) is extreme
